I found your order Shop····. It's paid, and the Magic M. 40T hasn't shipped yet. It was due to ship November 14, so it's now late. I'm sorry, and I'm also sorry nobody wrote to you about it.

There was a control board problem during production. That's fixed now, and the final version has been approved. Since the old date has passed, I've asked the team for the current ship date. They're offline right now, so they'll pick it up today at 10am ET and email you the answer. Tracking also goes to this email the moment your miner ships.
